newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian fertiliser firm ups profits in H1.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian fertiliser firm ups profits in H1.

text.p: Egyptian Financial and Industrial said on Wednesday its after-tax profits in the first six months of 1996/97 rose to 24.099 million pounds ($7.1 million) from 15.545 million in the same period of the previous year.
The financial year ends on June 30.
Sales in the July-December period increased 22 percent to 121.474 million pounds from 99.323 million, the fertiliser firm said in published financial statements.
Exports also went up to 37.277 million pounds in the first half of 1996/97 from 20.415 million in the same period of 1995/96, the figures showed.
Shareholders' funds reached 72.00 million pounds at the end of December 1996, against 55.00 million one year earlier.
The state privatised 65 percent of the company's 3.249 million shares in May at 30.00 pounds each.
The shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Wednesday at 200.00 pounds.
